# What the data-dict export loses: National Longitudinal Survey of Youth 1997 (NLSY97)

The YAML files here follow data-dict spec 0.1.0. They describe the common data format, so they validate against its parquet files. The records in `metadata/` remain canonical. This table counts what the export drops or flattens into text.

| | `1997-2023` |
|---|---|
| variables exported | 397 |
| variables whose numeric code labels went to `details` (no labeled numeric codes) | 386 |
| missing or unresolved codes, typed only in the `__code` column's labels | 1,895 |
| variables with several wordings, flattened into `details` | 6 |
| availability entries (wave by form, with n), summarized as one line of text | 661 |
| field origins (publisher, data file, rule, hand, model) not exported | 2,407 |
| groups (batteries, subjects, sections), not exported | 1 |
| release id not expressible as data-dict `version` (needs semver or a date) | 1 |
